1.Why This Matters:
Generally, you must pay all the costs from providers up to the deductible amount before this
plan begins to pay. If you have other family members on the plan, each family member must
meet their own individual deductible until the total amount of deductible expenses paid by all
family members meets the overall family deductible.

2.Why This Matters: This plan covers some items and services even if you haven’t yet met the deductible amount.

3.Important Questions:
Are there services

3.Answers:
Yes. Preventive care services are

3.Why This Matters: But a copayment or coinsurance may apply. For example, this plan covers certain preventive services without cost-sharing and before you meet your deductible. See a list of covered preventive services at https://www.healthcare.gov/coverage/preventive-care-benefits/.

4.Important Questions:
Are there other
deductibles for specific
services?
4.Why This Matters:
You don’t have to meet deductibles for specific services, but see chart starting on page 2 for
other costs for services this plan covers.

5.Important Questions:
What is the out-of-pocket
limit for this plan?
5.Why This Matters: The out-of-pocket limit is the most you could pay in a year for covered services. If you have other family members in this plan, they have to meet their own out-of-pocket limits until the overall family out-of-pocket limit has been met.

6.Important Questions:
What is not included in
the out-of-pocket limit?
6.Answers:
Premiums, balanced-billing
charges, and health care this plan
doesn’t cover.
6.Why This Matters: Even though you pay these expenses, they don’t count toward the out-of-pocket limit.

7.Important Questions: Will you pay less if you use a network provider?
7.Why This Matters: Even though you pay these expenses, they don’t count toward the out-of-pocket limit.

8.Important Questions:
Do you need a referral to
see a specialist?
8.Answers: No. You don’t need a referral to see a specialist.
8.Why This Matters: You can see the specialist you choose without permission from this plan.
